description: K562 7d prediction contract. Perturbed TFs: CREB1, E2F4, EGR1, ELF1, ELK1, ETS1, GABPA, IRF1, NR2C2, YY1. Target set is context-local (dataset-local 10-TF leave-one-out), not atlas-shared with HCC. 7d serves as temporal sensitivity / early-bridge probe alongside 13d.
scoring_gene_universe_note: GEARS: full 45-gene atlas-space output (complete prediction universe). Embedding-based entrants: genome-wide output restricted to atlas-overlapping gene subset. These universes are NOT identical; raw Spearman values are not strictly comparable across entrant families.

GEARS.note: GEARS outputs exactly 45 atlas gene columns, which is its complete prediction output space for this task

paper_role: temporal sensitivity / early-bridge probe alongside K562 13d primary formal supplementary bridge test
context_local_note: K562 target set is context-local and not atlas-shared with HCC. 7d provides temporal sensitivity probe. Together with 13d, forms the GSE90063 K562 13d/7d temporal panel supporting architecture-form temporal stability and bridge readout temporal stratification.
